name: supervisor-pane
description: A side pane that lists subagent runs and chosen shell commands with their state and elapsed time.

agents.title: Subagents to list
agents.description: subagent_type values that get a row. Leave empty to list every subagent.

commands.title: Shell commands to list
commands.description: Substrings; a Bash command containing one gets a row named after it. Leave empty to list no shell commands.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows
max_rows.description: Oldest finished rows are dropped beyond this count.
